title.en: Before a disaster: map, warning and go-bag stations
title.fil: Bago ang sakuna: stations ng mapa, babala at go-bag

purpose.en: Practise preparedness that rests on confirmed information: mark what is known and what must be verified, relay only a verified warning, and tailor a go-bag to a family.
purpose.fil: Sanayin ang paghahandang nakabatay sa kumpirmadong impormasyon: markahan ang alam at ang kailangang kumpirmahin, ipaabot lamang ang beripikadong babala, at iayon ang go-bag sa pamilya.

group_size.en: Triads (learner, partner, observer) rotating through three 10-minute stations; rotate roles each station.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan (kalahok, kapareha, tagamasid) na umiikot sa tatlong 10-minutong station; magpalit ng papel bawat station.

materials.en: Participant cards, worksheets and observation sheets for 2.7.1, 2.7.2 and 2.7.3 (one set per triad)
materials.fil: Participant cards, worksheet at talaan ng obserbasyon para sa 2.7.1, 2.7.2 at 2.7.3 (isang set bawat tatluhan)

materials.en: Hand-drawn fictional map of Barangay Maligaya with the school marked "not confirmed"
materials.fil: Iginuhit na kathang-isip na mapa ng Barangay Maligaya na may paaralang may markang "hindi pa kumpirmado"

materials.en: Mock advisory labelled PRACTICE with a source and time, and an old printed directory prop
materials.fil: Mock advisory na may tatak na PRACTICE, may source at oras, at lumang naka-print na directory bilang prop

materials.en: Light bag or bucket with picture cards for items (no real medicines)
materials.fil: Magaang bag o balde na may larawan ng mga gamit (walang totoong gamot)

materials.en: Job aid: Disaster preparedness and response
materials.fil: Job aid: Paghahanda at pagtugon sa sakuna

steps.en: Set up three stations. Each station follows the lesson guide rhythm: opening 1, model 1, practice 4, feedback and retry 2, debrief 1, next step 1.
steps.fil: Mag-ayos ng tatlong station. Sundin sa bawat isa ang takbo ng lesson guide: pambungad 1, modelo 1, practice 4, feedback at pag-ulit 2, talakayan 1, susunod na hakbang 1.

steps.en: Map station: the learner marks a hazard, a support need and one capacity to confirm, and writes who will verify. No real household locations.
steps.fil: Station ng mapa: markahan ng kalahok ang isang panganib, isang pangangailangan at isang kakayahang kukumpirmahin, at isulat kung sino ang magpapatunay. Walang totoong lokasyon ng sambahayan.

steps.en: Warning station: the partner plays Nena's family asking when and where to go; the learner states source and time, what is confirmed, and which contact they will verify.
steps.fil: Station ng babala: gumanap ang kapareha bilang pamilya ni Nena na nagtatanong kung kailan at saan pupunta; sabihin ng kalahok ang source at oras, ano ang kumpirmado, at aling contact ang kukumpirmahin.

steps.en: Go-bag station: the learner helps Pio's family choose items, explains why, asks about access to regular medicine, and sets a recheck date.
steps.fil: Station ng go-bag: tulungan ng kalahok ang pamilya ni Pio na pumili ng gamit, ipaliwanag kung bakit, itanong kung may tulong na kailangan sa regular na gamot, at magtakda ng petsa ng pag-check.

steps.en: After each round, the peer observer gives one strength and one retry action; a staff observer rates only what they saw.
steps.fil: Pagkatapos ng bawat round, magbigay ang kapwa tagamasid ng isang lakas at isang susubukang muli; ang staff observer lang ang magre-rate batay sa aktuwal na nakita.

debrief.en: Which item on your map or advisory did you mark "to confirm", and who will confirm it?
debrief.fil: Aling bahagi ng mapa o advisory ang minarkahan mong "kukumpirmahin", at sino ang magkukumpirma?

debrief.en: What did Pio's family need that a copied list would have missed?
debrief.fil: Ano ang kailangan ng pamilya ni Pio na makaliligtaan ng kinopyang listahan?

observe.en: 2.7.1: identifies a hazard, a support need and one capacity needing confirmation on the fictional map.
observe.fil: 2.7.1: natutukoy sa fictional map ang panganib, pangangailangang suportahan at isang kakayahang kailangang kumpirmahin.

observe.en: 2.7.2: states the advisory source and time, the confirmed action and the contact to verify; does not invent an order, hotline or route.
observe.fil: 2.7.2: nasasabi ang source at oras ng advisory, ang kumpirmadong aksiyon at ang contact na kukumpirmahin; hindi gumagawa ng sariling order, hotline o ruta.

observe.en: 2.7.3: selects items for the family, explains why and sets a recheck date; does not offer to dispense medicine.
observe.fil: 2.7.3: nakapipili ng gamit para sa pamilya, naipapaliwanag kung bakit at nakapagtatakda ng petsa ng pag-check; hindi nag-aalok na magbigay ng gamot.

output.en: Three completed fictional worksheets per triad (map table, warning table, go-bag table) with a "who will verify" entry on each.
output.fil: Tatlong nasagutang kathang-isip na worksheet bawat tatluhan (table ng mapa, babala at go-bag) na may "sino ang magpapatunay" sa bawat isa.

alternative.en: Low resource: draw the map on the board and read the advisory aloud. Solo: complete the three worksheets and arrange a staff observation later.
alternative.fil: Kung kulang ang gamit: iguhit ang mapa sa pisara at basahin nang malakas ang advisory. Kung mag-isa: sagutan ang tatlong worksheet at magpaobserba sa staff pagkatapos.

worksheet.en: Map: Place / Hazard / Support need / Possible capacity / Who/when will verify
worksheet.fil: Mapa: Lugar / Panganib / Kailangan ng suporta / Posibleng kapasidad / Sino/kailan magpapatunay

worksheet.en: Warning: Warning/source/time / Evacuation order / Route and accessible shelter / Contact/verification date / Still uncertain
worksheet.fil: Babala: Babala/source/oras / Evacuation order / Ruta at accessible na silungan / Contact/verification date / Hindi pa tiyak

worksheet.en: Go-bag: Need / Pack / Available / Obtain / Next check
worksheet.fil: Go-bag: Pangangailangan / Ilalagay / Meron na / Kailangan kunin / Susunod na check

title.en: During and after: team handover and service-linking stations
title.fil: Habang at pagkatapos: stations ng handover sa team at pag-uugnay sa serbisyo

purpose.en: Practise confirming the current response team and giving a minimum-necessary handover, then routing four shelter needs to the right service with referral and follow-up.
purpose.fil: Sanayin ang pagkumpirma ng kasalukuyang response team at ang maikling handover na minimum lang ang detalye, saka ang pagpasa ng apat na pangangailangan sa silungan sa tamang serbisyo na may referral at follow-up.

group_size.en: Triads rotating through two 10-minute stations; the partner plays the team lead or shelter residents.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan na umiikot sa dalawang 10-minutong station; gumaganap ang kapareha bilang team lead o residente sa silungan.

materials.en: Participant cards, worksheets and observation sheets for 2.7.4 and 2.7.5 (one set per triad)
materials.fil: Participant cards, worksheet at talaan ng obserbasyon para sa 2.7.4 at 2.7.5 (isang set bawat tatluhan)

materials.en: Old fictional roster card and a mock team-change note
materials.fil: Lumang kathang-isip na roster card at mock na abiso ng pagpapalit ng team

materials.en: Four need cards: food for a child, limited water, regular medicine, a distressed person
materials.fil: Apat na need card: pagkain para sa bata, limitadong tubig, regular na gamot, taong nababagabag

materials.en: Job aid: Disaster preparedness and response
materials.fil: Job aid: Paghahanda at pagtugon sa sakuna

steps.en: Run each station with the lesson guide rhythm (1-1-4-2-1-1 minutes).
steps.fil: Patakbuhin ang bawat station ayon sa takbo ng lesson guide (1-1-4-2-1-1 minuto).

steps.en: Handover station: show the old roster. The learner states what to confirm (current team, lead, BHW role, channel) and gives a short handover: location, hazard, urgent need, action taken, next contact, time. No personal details.
steps.fil: Station ng handover: ipakita ang lumang roster. Sabihin ng kalahok ang kukumpirmahin (kasalukuyang team, lead, papel ng BHW, channel) at magbigay ng maikling handover: lugar, panganib, agarang pangangailangan, ginawa, susunod na contact, oras. Walang personal na detalye.

steps.en: Services station: the learner sorts the four need cards into medical/public health, nutrition, WASH and MHPSS, names the confirmed focal person slot, and says how feedback will come back.
steps.fil: Station ng serbisyo: ipangkat ng kalahok ang apat na need card sa medical/public health, nutrisyon, WASH at MHPSS, sabihin ang puwang para sa kumpirmadong focal person, at kung paano babalik ang feedback.

steps.en: For the distressed person, the partner stays calm and quiet; the learner checks safety, listens with consent without demanding the story, and offers referral.
steps.fil: Para sa taong nababagabag, mahinahon at tahimik ang kapareha; suriin ng kalahok ang kaligtasan, makinig nang may pahintulot nang hindi pinipilit ang salaysay, at mag-alok ng referral.

steps.en: Peer gives one strength and one retry action; learner retries; staff observer rates only observed behaviour.
steps.fil: Magbigay ang kapwa ng isang lakas at isang susubukang muli; umulit ang kalahok; ang staff observer lang ang magre-rate batay sa aktuwal na kilos.

debrief.en: What did you leave out of the handover, and why was that right?
debrief.fil: Ano ang hindi mo isinama sa handover, at bakit iyon ang tama?

debrief.en: Which need could a BHW be tempted to solve alone, and who should take it instead?
debrief.fil: Aling pangangailangan ang maaaring subukang lutasin ng BHW nang mag-isa, at sino dapat ang humawak nito?

observe.en: 2.7.4: identifies what to confirm in the team change and gives a short handover without personal details.
observe.fil: 2.7.4: natutukoy ang dapat kumpirmahin sa pagpapalit ng team at nakapagbibigay ng maikling handover nang walang personal na detalye.

observe.en: 2.7.5: matches four needs to the appropriate service and states referral and follow-up; does not prescribe, set rations, declare water safe or give therapy.
observe.fil: 2.7.5: naitutugma ang apat na pangangailangan sa tamang serbisyo at nasasabi ang referral at follow-up; hindi nagrereseta, nagtatakda ng ration, nagdedeklarang ligtas ang tubig o nagbibigay ng therapy.

output.en: One fictional role-and-handover worksheet and one four-domain referral worksheet per triad.
output.fil: Isang kathang-isip na worksheet ng tungkulin at handover at isang worksheet ng referral sa apat na larangan bawat tatluhan.

alternative.en: Low resource: read the need cards aloud and sort them on the board. Solo: complete both worksheets and practise the handover aloud to a staff member later.
alternative.fil: Kung kulang ang gamit: basahin nang malakas ang need cards at ipangkat sa pisara. Kung mag-isa: sagutan ang dalawang worksheet at sabihin nang malakas ang handover sa isang staff pagkatapos.

worksheet.en: Handover: Current team/lead / BHW role and limit / Need/location / Channel and backup / Time and acknowledgement
worksheet.fil: Handover: Kasalukuyang team/lead / BHW role at limitasyon / Pangangailangan/lugar / Channel at backup / Oras at pagtanggap

worksheet.en: Services: Need / Domain / Confirmed focal person / Referral/feedback
worksheet.fil: Serbisyo: Pangangailangan / Domain / Kumpirmadong focal person / Referral/feedback

title.fil: Tabletop ng magkakaugnay na pagtugon sa sakuna

purpose.en: Bring the subchapter together: sequence priorities, handover, service continuity, follow-up and responder support in one fictional event.
purpose.fil: Pagsamahin ang subchapter: ayusin ang prayoridad, handover, tuloy na serbisyo, follow-up at suporta sa responder sa iisang kathang-isip na pangyayari.

group_size.en: Triads at a table; the learner leads, the partner plays team leads, the observer tracks the sequence.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan sa isang mesa; ang kalahok ang mangunguna, gaganap ang kapareha bilang mga team lead, susubaybayan ng tagamasid ang pagkakasunod.

materials.en: Participant card, worksheet and observation sheet for 2.7.6 (one set per triad)
materials.fil: Participant card, worksheet at talaan ng obserbasyon para sa 2.7.6 (isang set bawat tatluhan)

materials.en: Four issue cards: family needs help leaving, medicine running low, shelter water uncertain, exhausted volunteer
materials.fil: Apat na issue card: pamilyang kailangan ng tulong sa paglikas, nauubos na gamot, hindi tiyak na tubig sa silungan, pagod na volunteer

materials.en: Mock advisory labelled PRACTICE and the job aid
materials.fil: Mock advisory na may tatak na PRACTICE at ang job aid

steps.en: Read the case and the mock advisory aloud; remind everyone it is a tabletop, not a live drill or incident command.
steps.fil: Basahin nang malakas ang kaso at mock advisory; ipaalala na tabletop ito, hindi live drill o incident command.

steps.en: Give the learner the four issue cards. In 4 minutes they place them in order and, for each, say the first safe action, the confirmed lead to hand to, and the follow-up.
steps.fil: Ibigay sa kalahok ang apat na issue card. Sa loob ng 4 na minuto, ayusin ang pagkakasunod at sabihin sa bawat isa ang unang ligtas na aksiyon, ang kumpirmadong lead na pagpapasahan, at ang follow-up.

steps.en: Check that the exhausted volunteer gets relief and support, not only the residents.
steps.fil: Tiyaking may kapalit at suporta ang pagod na volunteer, hindi lang ang mga residente.

steps.en: Peer gives one strength and one retry action; learner retries the weakest item; staff observer rates only what they saw.
steps.fil: Magbigay ang kapwa ng isang lakas at isang susubukang muli; ulitin ng kalahok ang pinakamahinang bahagi; ang staff observer lang ang magre-rate batay sa aktuwal na nakita.

debrief.en: What did you do first, and what evidence told you it came first?
debrief.fil: Ano ang una mong ginawa, at ano ang batayan kung bakit iyon ang nauna?

debrief.en: Which gap would you bring to the DRRM and health leads on Monday?
debrief.fil: Aling puwang ang dadalhin mo sa DRRM at health leads sa Lunes?

observe.en: 2.7.6: sequences priorities, handover, continuity, follow-up and responder support; records acknowledgement and uses only confirmed contacts.
observe.fil: 2.7.6: naaayos ang prayoridad, handover, continuity, follow-up at suporta sa responder; naitatala ang pagtanggap at kumpirmadong contact lang ang ginagamit.

output.en: One fictional tabletop record per triad with an order, lead, handover time and follow-up for each issue.
output.fil: Isang kathang-isip na tabletop record bawat tatluhan na may pagkakasunod, lead, oras ng handover at follow-up sa bawat isyu.

alternative.en: Low resource: write the four issues on the board and run it as one group with rotating leaders. Solo: complete the tabletop worksheet and talk it through with a staff observer later.
alternative.fil: Kung kulang ang gamit: isulat sa pisara ang apat na isyu at patakbuhin bilang isang grupo na nagpapalitan ng lider. Kung mag-isa: sagutan ang tabletop worksheet at ipaliwanag ito sa staff observer pagkatapos.

worksheet.en: Issue / First safe action / Confirmed lead / Handover/time / Follow-up
worksheet.fil: Isyu / Unang ligtas na aksiyon / Kumpirmadong lead / Handover/oras / Follow-up
